title: YOG: Ajido finishes fifth in men's 100m butterfly
summary: Jamesray Mishael Ajido improved upon his time in the qualifiers but fell short of the podium in the final of the men's 100-meters butterfly finals in the 4th Youth Olympic Games, Sunday in Dakar.
